description: Purpose: list the revenue checks previously run on the authenticated Smoke Run account, newest first. When to use: the user asks for their check history, which sites were checked, or which runs are at risk; not for checking a new site. Inputs: siteUrl (optional, narrows to one site); limit (optional integer 1 to 100, default 50). Outputs: checks array, each with runId, siteUrl, status (healthy, at_risk, broken or inconclusive), dollarsAtRisk, mode, startedAt and finishedAt. Limits: needs a Smoke Run API key; read-only; summaries only, without full findings; does not run or fetch anything on the live site.

siteUrl.description: Optional. Narrow the list to one site.

name: list_checks
